note: Specific, novel, slightly ludicrous product ideas, replacing the sector axis in the company deck. The sector list was built to break convergence, six briefs producing six identical instrumentation companies, and it worked: municipal water utility, ferry operator, commercial bakery. It was also the least inspiring thing in the pipeline. Every brief said design documentation for a boring company, and no draw over sectors can produce an idea worth designing for. A specific concept can. The reviewer's example, and the register to aim at: Mixtape, one-hour YouTube playlists curated by real people in pop-culture niches. Not a category, not a market, a thing you can immediately picture and want to see designed. The point is to push the author out of distribution, so a concept that sounds slightly absurd and still coherent is doing its job.

axes.label: The idea
axes.note: Fictional throughout. Spread across software, hardware, services, physical places and things, because a deck of apps produces app design. A concept should be sayable in one line and immediately picturable.
